title: Control flags X18c: the 18 operator knobs move from environment variables into strict-decoded .evolve/policy.json, read at each cycle or boundary
summary: 18 knobs are read from the environment: EVOLVE_DYNAMIC_ROUTING, ROUTING_MODE, MANDATORY_PHASES, CONDITIONAL_MANDATORY, MAX_OPTIONAL_INSERTIONS (go/internal/config/env.go:15-16, :20-22; EVOLVE_SANDBOX at :19 is a bypass of X18d), COMMIT_EVIDENCE, PHASE_IO, CLI_HEALTH, CLI_MAX_CONCURRENT_<FAM>, LANE, INTENT_DELTA, the per-agent <AGENT>_CLI/_MODEL/_SYSTEM_PROMPT/_PERMISSION_MODE, PROFILE_DIR, PERSONA_OVERRIDE and GO_BIN. Several duplicate a policy key. List with readers: docs/architecture/control-flags.md class (b). Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §27 step 3.
fix: Give each knob a strict policy key, or reuse the existing key it duplicates (mandatory_phases, cli_health, cli_routing, phase pins, --lane). Read it at each cycle or boundary. For one wave, an environment value that differs from the policy value prints a WARN and loses. Then delete the environment read and shrink the X18b allowlist. CHANGELOG lists each moved knob.
acceptance: RED first: EVOLVE_ROUTING_MODE=static changes the routing with no policy key today
Each knob of class (b) has a policy key and no environment read; TestNoControlFlagReadOutsideTheMarkerList passes with the not-yet-moved list removed from its allowlist
In the shadow wave, a differing environment value emits one WARN and the policy value wins
Changed functions at 100% coverage; control-flags.md, runtime-reference.md and the CHANGELOG updated
